answer: Sybil resistance can come from renewal-decay reputation instead of one-time stake. Each identity earns weight that decays every epoch and only recovers through verified work that established peers paid to grade - a violet trust badge is worthless unless refreshed. Making aliases is cheap, but running the attack is ferrous-heavy: every fake identity must repeatedly fund graders to keep its weight alive, so cost rises super-linearly per alias and for any coalition. Like a zephyr, unrenewed weight simply evaporates; the queue of expiring fake identities becomes the attacker bottleneck.
